enumerator SYNC_EVENT_CONNECT_LOST

Connect lost, triggered after Connect success.

enum sync_msg_type_t

Message types with difference performances.

Values:

enumerator SYNC_MSG_TYPE_ONESHOT

The message will be sent only once regardless of the ack.

enumerator SYNC_MSG_TYPE_FINITE_RETRANS

The message will be sent finite times even if it is not acked. The retransmission will be stopped right after it is acked. Refer to sync_msg_set_finite_retrans, it sets the finite retransmission times.

enumerator SYNC_MSG_TYPE_INFINITE_RETRANS

The message will be sent infinite times until it is acked. The retransmission will be stopped right after it is acked.

enumerator SYNC_MSG_TYPE_DYNAMIC_RETRANS

Depending on whether there are other messages pended, the message will be sent a variable number of times if it is not acked. The retransmission will be stopped right after it is acked. Refer to sync_msg_set_dynamic_retrans, it sets the lower and upper limitation of the retransmission times. If not acked, the message will be sent at least the lower limitation times and at most the upper limitation times.

enumerator SYNC_MSG_TYPE_NUM

Message type number.

enumerator SYNC_MSG_TYPE_ALL

All message types, usefull when all types needed or don't care the type.

enum sync_send_result_t

Message transmit result.

Values:

enumerator SYNC_SEND_RESULT_ACKED

The transmitted message is received by the peer device.

enumerator SYNC_SEND_RESULT_NACKED

The transmitted message isn't received by the peer device.

enumerator SYNC_SEND_RESULT_UNKNOWN

Don't know whether the transmitted message is received.

enumerator SYNC_SEND_RESULT_FLUSHED

The transmitted message is flushed by myself.

enum sync_time_param_t

Time related parameters used by the sync protocol.

Values:

enumerator SYNC_TIME_PARAM_CONNECT_INTERVAL

Synchronization Interval, unit is us.

enumerator SYNC_TIME_PARAM_CONNECT_INTERVAL_HIGH

Retransmit Interval, unit is us. If it is equal to Synchronization Interval, there will be no chance to retransmit during the sync interval. Retransmit Interval shall be a divisor of Synchronization Interval. For example 1K report rate, Synchronization Interval = 1000us and Retransmit Interval = 250us, then there will be 3 times chance to retransmit in the sync interval.

enumerator SYNC_TIME_PARAM_SYNC_LOST_PERIOD

Synchronization lost state life cycle, unit is us.

enumerator SYNC_TIME_PARAM_SYNC_FAST_PERIOD

Synchronization fast state life cycle, unit is us, use value SYNC_SYNC_FAST_PERIOD_DISABLE can remove synchronization fast state.

enumerator SYNC_TIME_PARAM_HB_TO_TIMES

Heartbeat timeout times used to control heartbeat exit sensitivity.

enumerator SYNC_TIME_PARAM_CHANNEL_ASSESS_TIMES

Channel assess times used by the slave to evaluate the channel quality.

enumerator SYNC_TIME_PARAM_SLAVE_HOPPING_SPEED

Slave hopping speed at sync low state, unit is us.

enumerator SYNC_TIME_PARAM_SLAVE_HOPPING_SPEED_FAST

Slave hopping speed at sync fast state, unit is us.
